top_signals.title: CNBC Daily Open: Crude flows back at prewar levels, but at what cost?
top_signals.summary: Crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz return to prewar levels, but sharply higher prices at the pump continue to put pressure on the global economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump unveils $200 billion in U.S. energy investments by South Korea
top_signals.summary: South Korea had previously agreed to invest $350 billion in the United States and increase purchases of U.S. energy under a July 2025 trade deal.
